facts.fact: The Public Service Commission, with Mozilla and AFRALTI, certified 141 officers from 42 ministries, departments and agencies on 12 July 2024 after a data protection and cybersecurity capacity-building programme, and says it intends to train more.

facts.fact: The Public Service Commission trained and certified 141 public officers as data handlers on 12 July 2024 to ensure compliance with the Data Protection Act 2019.
The Director General of e-citizen said eCitizen has 11.8 million users and approximately 40,000 transactions daily.
